localChanges: chore: lock the engine packages that teach Settlers to clear terrain and carry water

log: `TerrainJobValue.improvement` widens to a string and gains an optional `action` (the `ActionLookup` name the worker needs), so a ruleset can offer jobs that aren't improvements, such as clearing a Swamp (civ-clone/web-renderer#353, #386). The four existing improvements keep their actions, so an existing policy runs unchanged.

`TerrainPolicy.tiles` optionally names the tiles a worker may be sent to; by default the player's cities' tiles, as before. A job that carries water to a dry tile can lie outside every city radius (civ-clone/web-renderer#426).

`jobCircumstances` fingerprints which terrain and which improvements are on a tile and its neighbours rather than counting improvements, so one improvement replacing another, or a terrain change, forgets a remembered undoable job at once (civ-clone/web-renderer#255).
Play is unchanged for an existing policy: an arena run of the pinned simple-ai-client on this package against itself gave a delta of exactly 0.
Food is weighted by the city's food surplus (0 or less, 1, 2, 3, more) rather than a single "at most 1" step, and irrigation counts a quarter more than its food alone (civ-clone/web-renderer#383).

`clearSwamp` and `clearJungle` (to Grassland) on a worked tile with no feature; `clearForest` (to Plains) with no feature where the Plains could then be irrigated, with that irrigation counted in, on a worked tile or one that carries water on (civ-clone/web-renderer#353, #386). Planting Forest was tried and dropped: it cost more than it gave in the arena.

A tile that could carry water (irrigable or a Forest with water beside it, not Hills) to a cardinal neighbour worth irrigating but dry is worth half of that irrigation too; `tiles()` adds such tiles outside the city radii. A dry tile water could reach isn't mined first when irrigating it would be worth more, and irrigation that is a neighbour's only water isn't mined until the neighbour is irrigated (civ-clone/web-renderer#426).

Tests cover the weights, each conversion and its conditions, and two maps run job by job until none is left: the one from #426 (its Desert Oasis is irrigated) and one where only a Forest outside the city radius can carry the water. Needs base-strategy-terrain-work 0.1.2.

Arena (80 games, 300 turns, two seed sets): score, population and cities unchanged; minedTiles -0.3 and -0.6 (t -1.5, -3.0). Dom chose to ship it for the jobs it gives Automated Settlers; details on civ-clone/web-renderer#353.
